children: The latest U.K. consumer price index data show annual headline inflation rose to 3.6% in October from 3.5% in September, indicating that inflationary pressures are still present, Jefferies' Modupe Adegbembo says in a note. While annual core inflation was unchanged at 2.8%, headline inflation is still moving higher and is expected to rise further, she says. "[Wednesday's] data support another hike, but we don't think they make the case for moving quickly." Investors expect an 80% chance of a Bank of England rate increase at the December 17 policy meeting, lower than the 90% chance priced in prior to the inflation data release, LSEG data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
